meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先宣布“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”；遇到触发词时，它自行组建 5 名互相敌对的评审（怀疑者、验证者、研究者、架构师、创意者），让他们互相攻击、挑错，只留下经得住批评的结论，再交给规划器(ulw-plan)产出可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“adversarial plan”等触发词，或要求进行对抗式/交叉批评规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个新功能。
say.note: 会启动 5 人对抗评审并产出可执行计划。

say.text: 发起 adversarial plan，审查我的方案。
say.note: 成员会互相攻击，只保留经得起批评的部分。

say.text: hpp 帮我找这个计划的盲点。
say.note: 会触发跨批评辩论，暴露薄弱假设。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", forms a 5-member hostile review team (skeptic, validator, researcher, architect, creative), runs cross-attacks between members, keeps only surviving insights, and passes them to a planner (ulw-plan) for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this feature.
say_en.note: Starts the 5-member adversarial review and outputs a plan.

say_en.text: Run adversarial plan to review my proposal.
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only defensible insights remain.

say_en.text: hpp, find blind spots in this plan.
say_en.note: Triggers cross-critique debate, exposing weak assumptions.
